title: SCANDAL: Leo XIV Caught Kneeling in 1995 Pachamama Ritual | REUPLOAD
description: NOTE: This episode of Faith & Reason originally aired on March 18, 2025. A photograph buried for decades has surfaced. It shows a young Augustinian priest, Robert Prevost, now Pope Leo XIV, kneeling in a circle, participating in a ritual explicitly labeled a “rite of Pachamama.” Multiple Augustinian witnesses have confirmed his identity. The year is 1995. The location is a symposium in South America. The ceremony is indigenous agricultural worship. The same earth deity venerated in the Vatican Gardens in 2019, processed into St. Peter’s, and placed before the tomb of the Apostle, was honored decades earlier by the man who now sits on the Throne of Peter. … Traditional Catholics Silenced Under Leo XIV’s Call for Unity A Stolen Catholic Daughter, Leo Elevates LGBT Heresy, and Synodality as a Code Word Leo XIV forbids TLM in St. Peter’s; Burke and Schneider push back

title: Pro-life, pro-family candidates make major gains in Ontario municipal elections
description: ( Campaign Life Coalition ) — We are pleased to provide you with a detailed analytical report on the results of the 2026 Ontario Municipal elections. As far as the pro-life and pro-family cause is concerned, it was a very successful election indeed! Campaign Life Coalition endorsed 237 candidates in contests for school board trustee, city council, and regional council across the province. … We would also like to directly thank every candidate who ran for public office along with their campaign teams and volunteers. Regardless of the outcome, your candidacies and campaigns gave voters a meaningful choice – the opportunity to vote with a clear conscience for someone who shares their beliefs. The value of this cannot be overstated. Your willingness to put your name on the ballot made this possible, and for that, we are truly grateful. In closing, we give thanks to almighty God for His blessing upon these candidates, and upon CLC’s efforts to elect godly men and women to public office. With child-like confidence in our loving Father, we will ask Him to increase His favour upon is in the next election.

title: Egypt seeks death penalty for man who converted from Islam to Christianity
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — An Egyptian man who converted to Christianity faces the death penalty after leaving Islam. As LifeSiteNews previously reported , Said Abdelrazek stands accused of promoting ideas and beliefs that are allegedly “harmful to national unity and social peace” as well as “showing contempt for Islam and challenging its fundamental principles.” However, human rights organizations, including Amnesty International and Coptic Solidarity, report that he is being unjustly persecuted for his conversion to the Christian faith. … The conditions at 10th of Ramadan Prison, where he is currently being held, are reportedly “abusive.” Amnesty International writes that the jail has “extensively documented cruel and inhuman detention conditions,” including “severe restrictions on movement, sunlight, and family contact.” Amnesty International and other human rights organizations have called for the immediate and unconditional release of Abdelrazek, whom they maintain is being detained and charged solely for converting from Islam to Christianity. Coptic Solidarity said that at the heart of the case lies the question of “whether an Egyptian citizen can freely leave Islam, embrace Christianity, and express his beliefs without being treated as a threat to the state.”
